mechanism: Cimetidine inhibits CYP450 enzymes (including CYP2D6 and CYP3A4) that metabolize fluphenazine, increasing fluphenazine plasma concentrations and pharmacological effects.
action: Monitor for increased antipsychotic effects and extrapyramidal side effects; consider dose reduction of fluphenazine or use alternative H2 blocker (famotidine or ranitidine) if interaction problematic.
